name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape. Changelog (last 3): 7.262.0 — Genesis now trusts its recorded facts instead of stand-ins: the MENUS gate and menus-done read the menu-written records (a hand-written menu file no longer advances the run, and menus-done names every open dimension with no record), and the design-brief and design-approval states derive from their marks alone, since the mark handlers already verify the artifacts. 7.261.0 — Mutation replay retired — the replay command, its script, corpus library and doctrine, the status-footer replay-due clause, fleet-reader's replay queries and review-legs' replay flag are removed; the escape ledger is the one ground-truth signal (ADR-0036). 7.260.0 — Review driver decides from recorded facts: a manifest's scope stamp (not file count) marks a fix-delta pass and counts the fix cap; marks.iteration is the live iteration; SKIPS re-fires per iteration against the gate count recorded at extraction; skips-extracted inside a fix round stays a fix-delta pass, refuses an empty file against a gate reporting skips and warns on a count mismatch; the ledger iteration is the fix-round count; ac-matrix skip routes 2 and 3 map a skip to the first AC cited at or after the test's own name.
